title: Synthesis of heptanuclear Ni4Dy3 coordination aggregate using tridentate ligand: X-ray structure, magnetism and theoretical studies

material_class.structural_family: heptanuclear Ni4Dy3 aggregate; 2,3,6M7-1 topology; two inverse Ni2Dy2 partial dicubanes sharing a central Dy

synthesis.procedure: H2L (0.023 g, 0.10 mmol) was dissolved in 10 mL of MeOH:CH2Cl2 (1:1, v/v). A 5 mL MeOH solution of Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (0.033 g, 0.075 mmol) and NEt3 (0.022 g, 0.20 mmol) was added. After 1 h stirring, a 10 mL MeOH solution of NiCl2·6H2O (0.024 g, 0.10 mmol) was added, then solid sodium benzoate (0.029 g, 0.20 mmol). The bright green mixture was stirred for an additional 4 h at room temperature, filtered, and kept for slow evaporation at 10–15 °C. Green block crystals of 1 were isolated after a week from the mother liquor.
synthesis.time: 1 h after Dy/NEt3 addition; additional 4 h after Ni/benzoate; crystals after 1 week
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution stirring followed by slow evaporation from the filtered mother liquor
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered and kept for slow evaporation at 10–15 °C; green block single crystals isolated after a week

properties.summary: χT at 290 K is 47.9 cm3 mol−1 K (0.1 T), matching uncoupled 4 NiII + 3 DyIII. χT decreases slowly then more sharply to 41.3 cm3 mol−1 K at 2 K. Magnetization M/Nβ = 23.5 at 2 K and 7 T is unsaturated. No slow magnetic relaxation under zero dc field; only a very small AC response below 3 K under 2000 Oe. DFT indicates weak ferromagnetic Ni–Ni exchange via benzoate; CASSCF finds low-lying Dy excited states with QTM probability, consistent with fast relaxation.

measurements.name: AC susceptibility / slow relaxation
measurements.value: no slow relaxation under zero dc field; very small response below 3 K under applied field
measurements.conditions: 40–2 K; 0 Oe and 2000 Oe dc field
